BACKPACK MAGAZINE.magazine_rules: The weapon only works while connected (an Action) to a worn Ammo Backpack, included. Reloading takes 2 extra Actions, the weapon can't be concealed, and it can't go in Cyberlimbs or Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mounts (ACPAs and Battlegloves are fine). Without BODY 13+, wearing the backpack gives -1 DEX and MOVE. Putting the backpack on or off is an Action, and the feed line can't be concealed.

BELT BOX.magazine_rules: The weapon can't be concealed or used as a Popup Weapon, and reloading takes 1 extra Action.
